title: The Optional Reagent
prompt: A default argument makes a reagent optional — omit it, and the default fills in. Predict each call.

rounds.explain: greet was called with only a name, so `word` falls back to its DEFAULT, 'Hail'.
This time you supplied `word` yourself — 'Yo' — which overrides the default. Give it and it's used; omit it and the default fills in.
